_comment: Ethereum mainnet USDG-vault deploy params. usd = Paxos USDG / Global Dollar (native Paxos issuance, 6 decimals, non-rebasing — balanceOf never includes unclaimed rewards; issuer holds pause/freeze/wipe + UUPS upgrade powers; re-verify symbol + decimals on-chain before deploy). wise = WISE token on Ethereum (burnWise works for this vault too). usdg forwards deposits to the worker (overhang-sweep) address: leave thirdParty zero (or equal to worker) — the deploy script enforces this and forces thirdParty = worker. worker: zero => the broadcasting deployer is used; set the production worker multisig before deploy (master-changeable afterwards). Params mirror the USDC vault: 3,000,000 cap, 20% rate. This chain launches DORMANT (active=false in the mesh manifest) — deposits gated, bridge/moves/withdrawals live.
